gloss: first meeting; first time meeting someone

definitions.explanation: The first time meeting someone face to face.

examples.japanese: {初対面|しょたいめん}の{人|ひと}と{話|はな}すのは{緊張|きんちょう}する。
examples.english: I get nervous talking to people I'm meeting for the first time.

examples.japanese: {初対面|しょたいめん}なのに{親|した}しく{話|はな}してくれた。
examples.english: Even though it was our first meeting, they talked to me in a friendly way.

examples.japanese: {初対面|しょたいめん}では{敬語|けいご}を{使|つか}うのが{普通|ふつう}だ。
examples.english: It's normal to use polite language when meeting someone for the first time.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{初|しょ} (first) + {対面|たいめん} (meeting face to face) → first face-to-face meeting

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{初対面|しょたいめん}の{人|ひと} - a person you're meeting for the first time
・{初対面|しょたいめん}なのに - even though it's the first meeting
・{初対面|しょたいめん}では - at a first meeting

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese culture, {初対面|しょたいめん} situations typically call for more formal language and behavior. Using polite speech ({敬語|けいご}) and maintaining appropriate distance are expected.
